title: Air-Fryer Salmon
summary: Salmon fillets in the air fryer: 7-10 minutes at 200 °C, no turning, crisp outside and moist inside.

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to {temp:200} for {timer:3} while you prepare the fish. It helps give the outside a crisp sear.
Pat the fillets dry with kitchen paper. Rub them lightly with oil, then season generously with salt, black pepper and garlic powder.
Lay them in the basket skin side down, in a single layer with space between them so the hot air can circulate. If they would overlap, cook them in two batches.
Air fry for {timer:7-10}, without turning them. They are done when the flesh flakes easily with a fork and the thickest part reaches {temp:63!}.

tips: Time it by thickness: about 1 cm takes 7-8 minutes, about 2.5 cm 8-10 minutes, and 4 cm or more 10-12 minutes, all to 63 °C in the thickest part.
For medium-rare to medium salmon, take the fillets out at 52-57 °C and let them rest on a plate for 3-5 minutes: the remaining heat finishes them without drying them out.
